from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """A single financial report extracted from one company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the filing")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label for the profit metric, e.g. 'Net Income', 'Net Loss'")
    profit_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported profit or loss amount")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount, e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. 'Quarter ended March 31, 2024'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
